QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_35

question.text: For a Cat III AIF, SEBI regulations require that the NAV calculation function be:

answer.text: Performed by the Chief Investment Officer personally
Independent from the fund-management function and disclosed at quarterly intervals for close-ended and monthly for open-ended schemes
Performed weekly, regardless of scheme structure
Published to the general public via newspaper

explanation.text: The Logic: For Cat III funds, NAV calculation shall be independent from the fund-management function and disclosed to investors at quarterly intervals for close-ended funds and at monthly intervals for open-ended funds. Listed debt and unlisted securities require independent valuation. The Trap: CIO-computed NAV (A) violates the independence rule. Weekly disclosure (C) is not the prescribed cadence. Public newspaper publication (D) confuses AIFs with mutual funds. Note: NAV independence and the quarterly/monthly disclosure cadence are covered in the workbook on pp. 307, 339 and 350.
